title: Journalists protest at Delhi police station over alleged sexual harassment
seoTitle: Delhi journalists protest alleged sexual harassment

tea.why: Protesters gathered after three women journalists alleged sexual harassment by police personnel during an October 3 protest at Jantar Mantar.
tea.want: Protesters demanded the registration of a First Information Report (FIR) against the accused police officer and a probe into the allegations.
tea.changed: Oct 5: Police detained 17 protesters, including one of the journalists, and later registered an FIR against them.

summary: Independent journalists and activists protested outside the Parliament Street police station in Delhi, demanding action regarding alleged sexual harassment of three women journalists by police personnel. The alleged incidents occurred during an October 3 protest at Jantar Mantar. Protesters sought the registration of a First Information Report (FIR) against the accused officer, examination of CCTV footage, and an investigation into the complaints. On October 5, Delhi Police detained 17 protesters, including one of the journalists, citing prohibitory orders. An FIR was subsequently registered against these 17 individuals, who were later granted conditional bail. The police also stated that the sexual harassment complaints were transferred to the Crime Branch for inquiry.
demands: Registration of an FIR against the accused police officer
Probe into allegations of sexual harassment
Examination of CCTV footage of the alleged incident
response: Delhi Police detained 17 protesters, including a woman journalist, on October 5, citing prohibitory orders. An FIR was registered against these 17 protesters. The police also transferred the sexual harassment complaints to the Crime Branch for inquiry and stated that allegations of physical assault on female protesters were baseless.

updates.text: Three women journalists alleged sexual harassment by police personnel during a protest at Jantar Mantar.
Independent journalists and activists began protesting outside Parliament Street police station.
Delhi Police detained 17 protesters, including a woman journalist, from outside Parliament Street police station.
Delhi Police registered an FIR against the 17 detained protesters.
All 17 detained protesters were granted conditional bail by a Patiala House court.
The Delhi Police transferred the sexual harassment complaints to the Crime Branch for inquiry.
An Assistant Commissioner of Police accused in one of the sexual harassment allegations was promoted, though the order was later modified.
